item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: The Supreme Court is clearing the way for California schools to tell parents if their children identify as transgender without getting the student’s approval, granting an emergency appeal from a conservative legal group. The Monday order blocks for now a state law that bans automatic parental notification requirements.
